short_answer: For a one-off check of a bank CSV, try this local tool. Rocket Money also offers free subscription tracking; the difference here is that you do not need an account or a bank connection. Premium may suit people who want help cancelling subscriptions.
paywall: Subscription tracking itself is available on Rocket Money’s free plan. Its paid plan adds features including a subscription cancellation assistant and more advanced financial tools. See Rocket Money’s plan details and its cancellation assistant documentation. This tool is an alternative way to check a statement, not a claim that Rocket Money charges everyone to find subscriptions.
free_does:
• Opens comma, semicolon or tab-separated bank exports locally, with column matching and a choice of date and spending conventions.
  • Looks for similar payments to the same merchant at weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and yearly intervals.
  • Shows the matching transactions, estimated monthly and yearly costs, and older patterns to review.
  • Downloads the selected results as a CSV. No account, linked bank, upload or saved transaction history.

Use one account and one currency per file. Results are candidates: regular purchases can look like subscriptions, and irregular charges or changing descriptions can be missed.
when_pay: Rocket Money may suit you if you want ongoing tracking through connected accounts, a wider budgeting app, or its Premium cancellation assistant. This tool only analyses the CSV you open. It cannot monitor future charges, connect to your bank or cancel anything for you.
